messages.content:
Curaçao appeared in the FIFA World Cup for the first time in 2026.
On 18 November 2025, they topped their qualifying group and qualified for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, becoming the smallest nation by both population and area to qualify for the tournament.
2026 FIFA World Cup
On 14 June 2026, Livano Comenencia scored the first-ever FIFA World Cup goal in the history of Curaçao, netting in the 21st minute of their opening match against Germany in Houston.
The team reached the World Cup largely through players of Curaçaoan descent who were born and developed in the Netherlands, an approach that broadened under former Netherlands striker Patrick Kluivert from 2015.
FIFA World Cup record
FINAL: Curaçao appeared in the FIFA World Cup for the first time in 2026.
